summary: Defines a common set of data types and parsing rules, called Structured Fields, so that new HTTP header and trailer fields can use one strict, well-defined syntax instead of each inventing its own. This makes such fields easier and safer to define and handle. It was replaced by RFC 9651.

eli5.summary: Instead of every HTTP header being written in its own odd style, this gives them all a shared set of building blocks, like standard Lego bricks.

questions: how to define a new http header field syntax
